test_coverage_notes: AMMDelete is likely tested in integration/functional tests for AMM operations, such as 'AMMDelete_test.cpp', 'AMM_test.cpp', or broader DEX/AMM test suites. The specific validation paths (feature enablement, asset type checks, AMM existence, LP token balance) should be covered by tests that attempt to delete AMMs under various conditions (feature disabled, invalid asset types, non-existent AMMs, non-empty pools). Gaps may exist if tests do not explicitly cover all combinations of feature flags and asset types, or if negative cases (e.g., MPTIssue present, AMM not found) are not tested. No unit tests are shown in this file; coverage depends on external test files.
